content.text: /ext:medcp Pick a common antiseizure medicine and report how many epilepsy patients received it.
I'll explore the clinical database schema first, then query for epilepsy patients on an antiseizure medication.

This is an OMOP CDM database. I'll use levetiracetam (Keppra), a common antiseizure medicine, and count distinct epilepsy patients who received it. Epilepsy maps to SNOMED concept 380378; I'll use `concept_ancestor` to capture the drug and its descendants.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS n_epilepsy_patients_on_levetiracetam
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON de.drug_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
JOIN omop.concept ing
  ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ing.concept_id
 AND ing.concept_class_id = 'Ingredient'
 AND LOWER(ing.concept_name) = 'levetiracetam'
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
  ON de.person_id = co.person_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor cca
  ON co.condition_concept_id = cca.descendant_concept_id
 AND cca.ancestor_concept_id = 380378;

content.text:
**Levetiracetam (Keppra): 16,182 distinct epilepsy patients** received it in this OMOP database.

This counts patients with both (1) a drug exposure to levetiracetam or any of its descendant products, and (2) an epilepsy condition diagnosis (SNOMED "Epilepsy," concept 380378, including subtypes).
